bibliographic.title: The Sin Eater
bibliographic.author: Zephyrcloud
bibliographic.description:
Short, interactive fiction developed for The Bare Bones Jam 2026.

You are a thing that defies description, but what? Are you a monster, or just a thing to be feared by superstitious villagers?

Content Warnings: Dread; Death; Gore/Viscera; Blood; Animals in distress off-screen; Dead bodies decaying; Consumption of dead human flesh

Thumbnail images from pixabay and photoshopped by yours truly. No AI was used in the development of this story. Full screen recommended.
